title: Salman Paak
subtitle: Independent
description: Salman Paak, alongside his son Wilmon, was the owner and operator of the Repaak Salyard on the planet Ferrix. In the back of his yard, hidden behind bundles of cro-plex and no-tarm tubing, he maintained a secret communications rig that could be used to contact Rebel agents across the stars. Bix Caleen used the rig, much to the eventual detriment of Salman.
